1068typedef struct QDMI_PROGRAM_FORMAT_T {
1069 uint32_t version;
1070 uint32_t encoding;
1071 char id[QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE];
1072 char profile[QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE];
1073} QDMI_Program_Format;
1074
1075#ifdef __cplusplus
1076static_assert(sizeof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 136U);
1077static_assert(alignof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 4U);
1078static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, version) == 0U);
1079static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, encoding) == 4U);
1080static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, id) == 8U);
1081static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, profile) == 72U);
1082#else
1083_Static_assert(sizeof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 136U,
1084 "QDMI_Program_Format must be 136 bytes");
1085_Static_assert(_Alignof(QDMI_Program_Format) == 4U,
1086 "QDMI_Program_Format must have four-byte alignment");
1087_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, version) == 0U,
1088 "QDMI_Program_Format.version must start at byte 0");
1089_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, encoding) == 4U,
1090 "QDMI_Program_Format.encoding must start at byte 4");
1091_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, id) == 8U,
1092 "QDMI_Program_Format.id must start at byte 8");
1093_Static_assert(offsetof(QDMI_Program_Format, profile) == 72U,
1094 "QDMI_Program_Format.profile must start at byte 72");
1095#endif

1103static inline int
1104QDMI_program_format_equal(const QDMI_Program_Format *const lhs,
1105 const QDMI_Program_Format *const rhs) {
1106 if (lhs == NULL || rhs == NULL || lhs->version != rhs->version ||
1107 lhs->encoding != rhs->encoding) {
1108 return 0;
1109 }
1110 for (size_t index = 0U; index < QDMI_PROGRAM_ID_SIZE; ++index) {
1111 if (lhs->id[index] != rhs->id[index] ||
1112 lhs->profile[index] != rhs->profile[index]) {
1113 return 0;
1114 }
1115 }
1116 return 1;
1117}
